offer.title: Schedule an interview
offer.description: Offer 2 or 3 times. The candidate sees them in their own time zone and picks one, or asks for other times.
offer.linkInvalid: Enter a link that starts with https://
offer.phoneHint: You call the candidate on the phone number in their profile. It is shown to you once the interview is booked.
offer.slotsHint: In your time zone. Each time can be picked until 1 hour before it starts.
offer.aiNotesHint: Audio only, and only if you both agree on screen when the call starts. The audio is deleted once the notes are ready.

slotErrors.too_soon: Choose a time at least 1 hour from now.
slotErrors.invalid: Choose a date, a time and a length.

card.title: Interview
card.aiNotesRequested: AI notes requested: you will both be asked when the call starts.
card.waiting: Waiting for {{name}} to pick a time.
card.pickHint: Pick the time that suits you (shown in your time zone).
card.otherTimesSent: You asked for other times. The company will offer new ones.
card.rescheduleSent: You asked to move this interview. It stays booked until the company offers new times.
card.joinOpens: You can join from 10 minutes before the start.
card.expired: No time was picked before the offered times passed.

mode.phoneRecruiter: Phone call: call the candidate on {{phone}}
mode.phoneCandidate: Phone call: the recruiter calls you on the number in your profile

otherTimes.title: Ask for other times
otherTimes.description: Tell the company when you are free. They will offer new times.
otherTimes.label: When suits you?

askReschedule.title: Ask to reschedule
askReschedule.description: Your interview stays booked until the company offers new times.
askReschedule.label: Why do you need to move it?

cancel.title: Cancel the interview
cancel.description: {{name}} is told by email, with a calendar cancellation if a time was booked.
cancel.label: Reason (optional)

outcome.title: Record the outcome
outcome.description: How did the interview with {{name}} go? Only your company sees this.
outcome.noteHint: Only your company sees this note.

noShow.title: Didn’t attend
noShow.description: {{name}} did not attend. Offer new times, or close the application as not selected.

notes.title: AI interview notes
notes.description: Made from the recording of your interview with {{name}}. Only your company sees them.

documents.title: Documents requested
documents.declineDescription: Tell the company why you cannot share this document.
documents.privacyCandidate: Only this company can open your files, and every opening is recorded.
documents.privacyRecruiter: Every opening of these files is recorded.

requestDocuments.title: Request documents
requestDocuments.description: The candidate uploads each document into the card. Only your company can open the files.

call.cannotJoin: You cannot join this interview now

reasons.too_early: The interview opens 10 minutes before the start.
reasons.closed: The time to join this interview has passed.

call.title: Interview: {{job}}
call.consentText: The recruiter would like AI notes of this interview. Only the audio is recorded, and only if you both agree. If either of you declines, the interview goes ahead without notes.
call.notesOff: AI notes are off for this interview.
call.waitingConsent: Recording starts when you have both agreed and you are both in the call.
call.failedTitle: We couldn’t connect the video call
call.fallbackCandidate: The recruiter can call you on {{phone}} instead.
call.fallbackNoPhone: Contact each other in the conversation to agree another way to talk.
call.mediaError: Allow your camera and microphone in the browser to take part in the call.
call.waiting: Waiting for the other person to join

move.title: Cancel the interview too?
move.text: You are moving this application out of the Interview stage. Cancel the interview as well? The candidate is told, with a calendar cancellation if a time was booked.
move.alsoCancel: Also cancel the interview under way
